name: 97113 · Cornelius, OR
findings: ZIP 97113 (Cornelius) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97113 (Cornelius) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
